title: Mapped scan snapshot
statement: Let $d$ be a four-tape configuration over an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $p\in\mathbb Z$, and let $b,e,w$ be words over $\Gamma$. For a function $f:\Gamma\to\Gamma$ and a destination tape $j$ equal to either tape $1$ or tape $3$, assume that $b=w$ if $j=1$ and $e=w$ if $j=3$. Starting from the snapshot of $d$ in the forward scan state, with offset $p$ and buffers $b,e$, the scan machine that applies $f$ to symbols on tape $j$ reaches after $2|w|+2$ steps the done-state snapshot with offset $p$, with that tape's buffer replaced by the word obtained by applying $f$ entrywise to $w$ and the other buffer unchanged. Before that time it is never in a done state; at every time up to and including that time, the head on tape $j$ lies between the initial head position minus one and the initial head position plus $|w|$, inclusive, and every other work-tape head remains at its position in the initial snapshot.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is a tape index in a four-tape machine
